set.body: Found by S20: GeometryPaneHost/GeometryPanelView is not mounted in StudioWindow. The Data perspective's Geometry pane hosts only the import wizard's geometry form (StudioWindow.scala ~:128, ~:531: mapping.geometry.node), so the density picture and key (tickets 23-24), the thumbnails and the all-trials overlay (PARITY Data: 'Thumbnails and the all-trials overlay'), and the missing-asset hatch (25) exist only in tests. Mount the panel where the Data board draws it (docs/studio/design/Data.dc.html Geometry section: the frame/placement form, then density, key, thumbnails, overlay, 'Mark trial as wrong orientation…'), wire GeometryInputs.of(session, displays) as S20 left it, keep one Tab-stop model, and add an FX check that the Data moment t1 shows the density key and the P01 · enc_08 'Missing asset · forest-044.png' thumbnail in the real window (ShellMomentsFxSuite or a t1 journey). Epic bd-01M4R9BYCYAZAPHYSK79MVWHKW.
set.title: [S26] Mount the geometry panel in the Data perspective
